alt: The Add another reference button below the reference cards on the reference request form
needs: Extra references allowed (settings_json.is_additional_references_enabled, on by default)

alt: The Start date and End date fields with the Present checkbox on a reference card of the reference request form
needs: Reference dates enabled (is_reference_dates_enabled, on by default)

alt: The red Submit button with the "Please complete the following before submitting" list below it on the reference request form
The top of the reference form with the "If this request is not relevant to you or you wish to decline it, please click here." line
needs: Decline option enabled for the firm (is_reference_is_declinable_enabled, off by default); the link appears 3 s after load

alt: The Documents section of the reference request form with the upload area and the Browse files button
needs: Candidate document upload enabled (settings_json.candidate_documents.enabled, Ref. Requests tab) with a short description

alt: The Activities page with the date range picker, the Everyone/Myself toggle and the activity table
needs: Some activity in the docs firm within the last month

alt: The Notifications panel open from the bell in the top bar, with Mark all as read and View all notifications
needs: At least one published announcement targeting root recruiters

alt: The Import candidates window with the Download the CSV template link and the file drop area
needs: Not a demo firm; recruiter signed in to the main account (button is disabled on sub-accounts)

alt: The Export window with the Tables dropdown, the Date range picker and the Fields list
The Leads page with the lead-type counts, the filter toolbar and the list of leads
needs: Lead generation on with 2 lead types, and a few references that submitted themselves as leads in the last month

alt: The Leads settings page with the switch, Company description, Consent checkbox and the Number of lead types to collect dropdown
needs: Lead generation switched on, with a company description, the consent checkbox on with its text, and 2 lead types

alt: The References overview with the toolbar (date range, Everyone/Myself toggle, view dropdown), the four tiles and the daily chart
needs: Candidates and completed references in the last month
